# Ian Henriques

> Personal site of Ian Henriques (@logflash) — Ph.D. student in EECS at MIT
> working on signal-based foundation models for medical applications; formerly
> ECE at Princeton (B.S.E., M.Eng.) and a founding engineer at General
> Translation. The site is a single page with sections for About, Research,
> Projects, and Contact, available in English, Spanish, and Japanese.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://ianhenriques.com/en): bio, research, projects, and contact details
- [Inicio (Español)](https://ianhenriques.com/es): the same content in Spanish
- [ホーム（日本語）](https://ianhenriques.com/ja): the same content in Japanese
- [Resume (PDF)](https://ianhenriques.com/IanResume_14.3.pdf): full curriculum vitae

## Research

- [SweetDeep: Predicting Type 2 Diabetes with Smartwatches (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.03471): compact neural network detecting type 2 diabetes from smartwatch data
